name: Living Cautery Convergence
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.8-block radius for 13 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 4.75 ❤ thermal
• Heals 2 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 4 s
